hits_requiring_fix.before: FIRST MEASUREMENT of Decisio 0.9.0 on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B in this intake (submitted through the form). A NEW ROW of the Decisio family, with a different base from the live Gemma-based Decisio rows; it replaces none of them. 'Jev-compatible' describes the interface only. SERVED WEIGHTS: base_model Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (served: Qwen's official FP8 release at 95a723d0). These are the official Qwen FP8 weights, not a Decisio fine-tune; the server is aminry/decisio v0.9.0, run as frozen in code_revision. SIBLING CHECK: none of the 42 weight-shard LFS hashes equals an LFS blob of the 173 live row repositories in the pre-launch snapshot (171 checked; Uniphore/uniphore-4b-decider and nemotron-deciffusion/Nemotron-Deciffusion-8B-v2 returned 401 and were unchecked). This compares bytes at repository HEAD, not each published row's revision, and is not a claim of independent training. PROMPT AND READOUT: one user turn with state, instructions and lettered options, Qwen chat template with thinking disabled, and an Answer: prefill; up to 1,055 leading newline tokens pad the state prefix to the hybrid's 1,056-token block. No system turn. Yes/no is presented as A. No and B. Yes, with any side descriptions retained, and the returned probabilities are keyed back to yes/no. Choice defaults hide index-like keys, describe options and desnake bare labels; these are item-blind label-shape rules, never answer-key changes. Score levels are lettered options. One label-logprob readout per question, max_tokens 1, no generated explanation; softmax probabilities are temperature-scaled at 1.370 for choice and 1.506 for yes/no and score, preserving argmax. No commit rule, no task-specific calibration or abstention, no ensemble and no retry. TEMPERATURE FIT (author statement): the source describes fitting on the author's private 1,400-item suite; the examples were not inspected and overlap with JevBench was not independently checked. Base-model training contamination of the sealed draw is unchecked. PREFIX CACHE: standard vLLM automatic prefix caching is on, with Mamba align mode; repeated padded state prefixes can reuse KV/GDN state across requests. Its floating-point effect is part of the served configuration; the replay also reads the cache. SPECULATIVE DECODING/MTP OFF, despite the shipped MTP weights. CONTEXT AND REFUSALS: the frozen tag has no dedicated over-limit refusal handler and no truncation. An engine prompt of 32,767 tokens is accepted; 32,768 or more triggers vLLM's context-length validation exception, which this tag leaves as bare HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error'. Exactly the 15 preregistered over-length items returned that bare 500 with the required context-error log evidence and are scored as misses, without retry or partial credit. The other 1,485 items returned HTTP 200; total 1,500 rows. Native outcome deviations are record-only under the preregistered amendment, never a reason to retry or improve a score: measured outcome deviations 0. The wrapper's remaining post-sealed stops concern infrastructure/configuration and the frozen driver's own unchanged stop rule. USAGE AND BILLING: server-reported 664,205 input and 1,485 output tokens; 0 usage mismatches against the offline count. Input usage counts state and question text without padding or template; the billed input is instead the preregistered engine-prompt transcription, 1,761,623, as detailed in cost_basis. A server-observed engine count was unavailable under the frozen configuration, so the native usage agreement is not an independent validation of the engine total. The earlier preregistration estimate near 1.13x the cap used a rough usage basis and is superseded by engine-basis billing, 2.77x the cap on the common basis. HARDWARE AND LATENCY: one RTX PRO 6000 96 GB, so these measurements do not establish latency on any other card or hosted service. Measured loopback p95 about 0.07 s, maximum about 0.13 s, 0 requests over 10 s; scored loop 91 s. No decision receives a time-limit miss in the v1.7 share view on these timings. That view uses the common self-hosted latency estimate (2 times measured p50 plus 0.15 s), an assumption about hosted latency rather than a hosted-endpoint measurement. DETERMINISM (record-only): first 50 requests replayed twice after scoring, 50/50 bit-identical, 0 argmax flips, maximum probability difference 0.0. The scored run stands. PREREGISTRATION: append-only amendments before any pod froze MTP off and both input totals, changed native outcome deviations to record-only, and selected engine-input billing with an explicit offline-transcription limitation. The earlier suggestion that extra head-recompute requests should enlarge this run's engine basis was corrected: with empty tasks and debug off they do not occur on the frozen route, and no phantom tokens are billed. ATTEMPT HISTORY: create calls 1-5 failed with Verda HTTP 503 before an instance existed (absence receipts retained). Call 6 was the sole measured attempt; zero sealed items reached a model before it. LICENCE: Decisio server Apache-2.0 with NOTICE; Qwen weights Apache-2.0, ungated.
